proposed.label: Confirmed customer collections
proposed.definition: Confirmed accepted collections less source-defined reversals; security and advances remain separately classified, not sales.
proposed.qualityGate: Missing owner/grant/required facts is unavailable, never zero.
proposed.rounding: Display precision and rounding come from currency metadata and approved owner policy.

proposed.label: Payments applied
proposed.definition: Sum confirmed current allocations to selected invoices, net of reversed allocations. Receipt date may lie outside invoice period.
proposed.qualityGate: Missing owner/grant/required facts is unavailable, never zero.
proposed.rounding: Display precision and rounding come from currency metadata and approved owner policy.

proposed.label: Customer balances
proposed.definition: Owner-confirmed positive invoice balances after confirmed credits/debits and allocations. Do not net unrelated customer credit silently.
proposed.qualityGate: Missing owner/grant/required facts is unavailable, never zero.
proposed.rounding: Display precision and rounding come from currency metadata and approved owner policy.

proposed.label: Overdue customer balances
proposed.definition: Subset of positive balances overdue under the issuer basis. Missing due date stays No due date.
proposed.qualityGate: Missing owner/grant/required facts is unavailable, never zero.
proposed.rounding: Display precision and rounding come from currency metadata and approved owner policy.

proposed.label: Unapplied customer credit
proposed.definition: Owner-confirmed available credit not yet allocated. This is not negative debt or earned revenue.
proposed.qualityGate: Missing owner/grant/required facts is unavailable, never zero.
proposed.rounding: Display precision and rounding come from currency metadata and approved owner policy.

proposed.label: Security collected
proposed.definition: Collected refundable security only; exclude authorizations, rental charges and reservation fees.
proposed.qualityGate: Missing owner/grant/required facts is unavailable, never zero.
proposed.rounding: Display precision and rounding come from currency metadata and approved owner policy.

proposed.label: Recorded security balance
proposed.definition: Owner-recorded obligation after confirmed returns/owner-confirmed posted charge allocations; unknown refund outcomes remain unresolved with quality overlay.
proposed.qualityGate: Missing owner/grant/required facts is unavailable, never zero.
proposed.rounding: Display precision and rounding come from currency metadata and approved owner policy.

proposed.label: Security refunds confirmed
proposed.definition: Owner-confirmed money returned from collected security; exclude authorization release and requested/unknown refunds.
proposed.qualityGate: Missing owner/grant/required facts is unavailable, never zero.
proposed.rounding: Display precision and rounding come from currency metadata and approved owner policy.

proposed.label: Booking advances collected
proposed.definition: Only accepted advances intended to credit a later bill; separate agreed fees have their own classification.
proposed.qualityGate: Missing owner/grant/required facts is unavailable, never zero.
proposed.rounding: Display precision and rounding come from currency metadata and approved owner policy.

proposed.label: Advances awaiting allocation
proposed.definition: Remaining classified customer advance not yet allocated/confirmed refunded. Never automatically recognized revenue.
proposed.qualityGate: Missing owner/grant/required facts is unavailable, never zero.
proposed.rounding: Display precision and rounding come from currency metadata and approved owner policy.

proposed.label: Recognized revenue
proposed.definition: Owner-defined recognized amount and revisions under accepted policy; no browser recognition calculation.
proposed.qualityGate: Missing owner/grant/required facts is unavailable, never zero.
proposed.rounding: Display precision and rounding come from currency metadata and approved owner policy.

proposed.label: Invoice total
proposed.definition: Owner-issued invoice total with separately identified credit amendments; exclude quote, draft and void states as defined by issuer.
proposed.qualityGate: Missing owner/grant/required facts is unavailable, never zero.
proposed.rounding: Display precision and rounding come from currency metadata and approved owner policy.

proposed.label: Credit notes
proposed.definition: Current confirmed credit-note allocation. A credit note is not proof of a cash refund.
proposed.qualityGate: Missing owner/grant/required facts is unavailable, never zero.
proposed.rounding: Display precision and rounding come from currency metadata and approved owner policy.

proposed.label: Ready for payout
proposed.definition: Owner-supplied eligible value after its holds/reserves and prior disbursements; not reconstructed from sales cards.
proposed.qualityGate: Missing owner/grant/required facts is unavailable, never zero.
proposed.rounding: Display precision and rounding come from currency metadata and approved owner policy.

proposed.label: Settlement reserve
proposed.definition: Owner-defined reserve and reason; release date only if confirmed. Excludes separately owned customer security.
proposed.qualityGate: Missing owner/grant/required facts is unavailable, never zero.
proposed.rounding: Display precision and rounding come from currency metadata and approved owner policy.

proposed.label: Money movement being checked
proposed.definition: Distinct unresolved money operation amounts in their currencies; not a confirmed loss, refund or payout.
proposed.qualityGate: Missing owner/grant/required facts is unavailable, never zero.
proposed.rounding: Display precision and rounding come from currency metadata and approved owner policy.

proposed.label: Accepted contract value
proposed.dateBasis: Acceptance period or current cohort, explicitly selected
proposed.definition: Versioned accepted scope value; not invoice debt, cash or recognized revenue.
proposed.qualityGate: Missing owner/grant/required facts is unavailable, never zero.
proposed.rounding: Display precision and rounding come from currency metadata and approved owner policy.

proposed.label: Billable milestones
proposed.definition: Only owner-confirmed billable unissued milestones. Not an invoice or collected money.
proposed.qualityGate: Missing owner/grant/required facts is unavailable, never zero.
proposed.rounding: Display precision and rounding come from currency metadata and approved owner policy.

proposed.label: Customer procurement funds
proposed.definition: Owner-classified procurement/pass-through budget, separate from merchant service fee.
proposed.qualityGate: Missing owner/grant/required facts is unavailable, never zero.
proposed.rounding: Display precision and rounding come from currency metadata and approved owner policy.

proposed.label: Supplier amount due
proposed.definition: Owner-confirmed supplier obligation under accepted principal/agent role; not NEXG merchant payout.
proposed.qualityGate: Missing owner/grant/required facts is unavailable, never zero.
proposed.rounding: Display precision and rounding come from currency metadata and approved owner policy.
